caption: The drawing features a central figure of a human-like character dressed in draped robes, standing on a two-wheeled chariot. The chariot is pulled by two winged lion-like creatures. The entire central scene, including the figure, chariot, and animals, is rendered in shades of white and pale red with detailed linework. The reins from the chariot are held by the human-like figure and extend to the creatures. The background is a solid dark blue. On either side of the central figures are two trees with brown branches and leaves highlighted in yellow and orange. There are tufts of grass near the base of the trees. On the ground near the front right wheel of the chariot, there are three vessels: two amphora-shaped jars and a bowl, all outlined in white with brown shading. The drawing is enclosed in two fine rectangular borders, one blue and one white, and there is a small cursive signature in the bottom right corner.
title: Bandbox Design
